packageRules.description: Supply-chain inputs (actions, container images) are always human-reviewed; label them for triage.
Org practice: automerge patch-level Go module updates once every check passes. platformAutomerge=false makes Renovate itself wait for all checks, independent of repo auto-merge settings.
Let new module and action releases age before proposing them, so a compromised or yanked release is usually caught upstream first. Docker registries without timestamps are excluded.
Actions are pinned to full-semver tags, so a digest-only change means the tag was moved (the tj-actions pattern). Never a routine PR: require explicit approval on the dependency dashboard.

Cluster API and the Kubernetes client libraries move together: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api vN is built against one k8s.io/* minor and one controller-runtime minor, and mixing them breaks the v1beta2 contract. Group them so a bump is reviewed as the single decision it is, never as separate automerged patches.

The go directive, the CI go-version pins and the builder image are one decision, not three. Hold them for explicit approval: the ceiling is set by the tooling that has to parse the module, not by what Go has released.
